high_level_description: This image captures a serene sunset scene at the Four Seasons Resort Nevis, West Indies. The setting is tranquil, with the sun low on the horizon, casting a warm orange glow over the calm ocean. The sky transitions from a soft blue near the top to a gradient of yellow and orange near the horizon. In the foreground, a person's legs are casually propped up on a wooden deck railing, wearing black high-heeled sandals.
